questions.text: THIS IS QUESTION PAPER FOR THE SUBJECT "FOUNDATION LEVEL : ENGLISH I (COMPUTER BASED EXAM)" ARE YOU SURE YOU HAVE TO WRITE EXAM FOR THIS SUBJECT? CROSS CHECK YOUR HALL TICKET TO CONFIRM THE SUBJECTS TO BE WRITTEN. (IF IT IS NOT THE CORRECT SUBJECT, PLS CHECK THE SECTION AT THE TOP FOR THE SUBJECTS REGISTERED BY YOU)
What does the popularity of documentaries suggest about audiences?
options: They are losing interest in real stories
They are more curious about the lives of those around them
They are less interested in politics
questions.correct_answer: They are more curious about the lives of those around them
questions.comprehension_passage: Read the following passage and answer the given subquestions: It’s one of the more heartening cinema trends of the past decade: the rise in popularity of the documentary speaks of a bolstered curiosity among audiences in the lives of those around them. It promises a degree of social and political engagement that fiction film-making can rarely achieve. It’s about real people getting to tell their stories. Except, as Jennifer Tiexiera and Camilla Hall’s piercing film about the subjects of documentaries reveals, it’s not quite as simple as that. Nonfiction film-making can have unintended and far-reaching consequences for the participants – Ahmed Hassan, subject of the Egyptian revolution doc The Square, now lives in exile. At its worst, it can be predatory, manipulative and morally murky. Interviewing the subjects of high-profile documentaries, including The Wolfpack, Capturing the Friedmans and Hoop Dreams, the picture interrogates the ethics of documentary film-making. It questions asymmetrical power dynamics, the issue of whether subjects should be paid for their participation and who has the right to tell a story in the first place. It’s thought-provoking stuff, which also explores our own role, as audience members, in the voracious demand for other people’s stories. Source: Subject review – piercing documentary about documentaries by Wendy Ide

questions.comprehension_passage: Answer the given subquestions based on the following letter: Date: [DD/MM/YYYY] To, The Municipal Commissioner Chennai Municipal Corporation [Office Address] Chennai – [Postal Code] Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Request for Improvement of Facilities at the Park in Adyar, Chennai I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing to bring to your attention several pressing issues concerning the facilities at the park located in Adyar, Chennai. As a regular visitor to this park, I have observed a number of concerns that I believe require your immediate intervention to ensure that the park can continue to serve as a pleasant and functional space for the community. Firstly, the park currently lacks a proper pavement, making it difficult and uncomfortable for visitors to walk, especially those who use wheelchairs or have mobility issues. The absence of a well-maintained walkway not only diminishes the accessibility of the park but also poses a safety risk to its users. Additionally, there is no clear schedule for the park’s opening and closing hours. This uncertainty causes inconvenience to visitors who are unsure of when they can access the park, leading to frustration and reduced usage. Another significant issue is the state of the park’s restrooms, which are consistently unclean and poorly maintained. This lack of proper sanitation detracts from the overall experience of park- goers and may discourage them from using the facilities. To address these issues, I would like to propose the following measures: 1. Installation of Proper Pavements: Constructing well-maintained walkways within the park would greatly enhance accessibility and safety for all visitors. 2. Establishment of Fixed Timings: Implementing a clear schedule for the park’s opening and closing hours will provide clarity and convenience for visitors. 3. Improvement of Sanitation Facilities: Regular cleaning and maintenance of the park’s restrooms will ensure a higher standard of hygiene and user satisfaction. I trust that you will consider these suggestions and take the necessary steps to improve the facilities at the Adyar park. Your prompt attention to these matters will greatly benefit the community and contribute to the overall betterment of our public spaces. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your positive response and the necessary actions to enhance the park’s facilities. Yours sincerely, XYZ
